prior_receipts: Historical code-specific evidence only; not authorization for this revision
target_identity: R2 shape locked: 28L, hidden1024, 16Q/8KV, head_dim128, MLP3072, vocab32768; exact local weight/tokenizer hashes required; shape is not weight-lineage proof
historical_dependency: experiments/attention_shape/README.md and src/variants.py; existing SWA negatives remain valid for their tested setup
primary_question: Can frozen R2 accept a periodic local/global retrofit with sink preservation, without mistaking mask correctness or cache arithmetic for model quality?
secondary_question: After separate reviewed training, do local/sink gates repair damage beyond identical all-global gate training?
invariants: Keep QKV/O, QK-Norm, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, full unscaled RoPE, tokenizer, embeddings and output head unchanged
No weight edits, downloaded models, context extension, kernel switching or inference parameter changes
Batch one; unpadded; no packing, beams, quantization, hooks, PEFT, GGUF or export
512 slots include current token and any 4 prefix sinks; sinks replace recent slots
Keep absolute positions across eviction; compact storage rather than views
Gates are 2*sigmoid(W*x), W=0; exactly identity with live gradient; no gate training now
Native eager full attention is the independent parity oracle; research arms share one backend/block size
Identical prefill prompts/output caps are not identical actual FLOPs when EOS lengths differ
No runtime or quality claim from topology, unit tests, logical cache or FLOP arithmetic alone

arms.A0_global: all-global frozen matched research backend; native forward remains independent oracle
arms.A1_local1024: periodic 3local/1global, W1024, no sinks/gates; secondary budget control
arms.A2_local512: periodic 3local/1global, W512, no sinks/gates; pure-window damage control
arms.A3_sink512: A2 with four initial slots inside W512; prespecified primary treatment
arms.A4_global_gate: A0 + identity gate; future trained-capacity control
arms.A7_sink1024: A1 with four initial slots inside W1024; secondary sink control
arms.A8_all_local512: all layers W512; no globals, sinks or gates; NOT compute-matched to A2
arms.A9_frontloaded512: same number of globals and final-global layer as A2, earlier global placements; equal modeled work/cache/parameters

stages.P0: CPU fixture and separately required native HF random-model integration; neither proves R2 quality
stages.P1: Local R2 asset inventory and exact weight/tokenizer/config hashes; no remote download or corpus scan
stages.P2: Native/global parity, full/stream equivalence, compact storage, identity gate, all-local and frontloaded controls; current code/env/backend receipts only
stages.P3: Receipt-gated open boundary diagnostics; max 10 arms x 72 prompts x 24 generated tokens; per-case workload and storage validation; never promotion
stages.P4: CLOSED: reviewed data/license/lineage/dedup and fixed optimizer/seed/checkpoint rules plus separately registered token- and compute-matched training
stages.P5: CLOSED: independent preservation/quality confirmation and isolated hardware benchmarking need separate preregistration

qualification.amended: 2026-09-09; supersedes the v1 absolute-tolerance verdict after it failed on the first real-R2 run
exact_conditions: attended absolute key positions identical between full and chunked prefill, every layer, every stream arm
argmax identical for every compared logit tensor

native_global bit-exact 0.0 against the native eager forward when backend is math AND the research forward issues a single query block (block_size >= sequence length); bit equality is unattainable otherwise because the two paths multiply different shapes
compact storage: logical_kv_bytes == resident_kv_bytes and registered retained counts
qualification.drift_control: A0_global global_stream max_abs_error measured in the same run, device, backend and seed
qualification.drift_calibration: correct implementations observed at ratio 1.0-7.3; injected eviction faults at 78162-1258638; K sits ~7x above the correct side and ~1500x below the nearest fault

superseded_v1.why: absolute logit bound calibrated on a 4-layer hidden-32 fixture; unachievable at 28 layers in float32, where chunked-vs-full prefill differs by ~12 ulps per layer by construction, and non-discriminating (sink_stream cleared 3.62e-05 while local_stream failed at 1.11e-04)
superseded_v1.still_reported: every receipt still records max_abs_error and registered_v1_tolerance_passed per check

qualification.note: Tiny mechanical windows do not measure 512/1024 quality or long-context throughput

diagnostics.prompt_protocol: raw completion, exact token lengths, no truncation or changed parser
diagnostics.decoding: greedy, max_new_tokens24; stop set = the checkpoint's declared EOS ids UNION every token whose decoding contains a newline; no repetition/abstention bias
diagnostics.comparison: Paired by ID/prompt/answer; named reference-treatment contrasts, strict/trimmed and answerability subsets; correlated DEV and unadjusted McNemar never confirmatory
diagnostics.gate_identity: A0=A4, A2=A5, A3=A6 token-for-token before training or reject diagnostic
diagnostics.execution_guard: Compare observed score-rectangle elements, attention-matmul work and each layer resident KV with planner using actual generated length
diagnostics.timing: Descriptive only; fixed arm order, no isolation proof, no causal speed claim

superseded_lengths_v1.why: measured against the window rule, 0 of 72 cases could put the answer outside a 1024-wide window, so A1_local1024 and A7_sink1024 could not exhibit a window effect at all; only 12 of 72 at question-read (24 of 72 by end of generation) could do so for a 512-wide window

diagnostics.length_rationale: these straddle the eviction threshold of BOTH registered windows; 512 remains an all-visible control; still 6 lengths x 4 families x 3 depths = 72 cases, within every registered budget
diagnostics.stop_rule: the registered prompt ends with a newline then 'Answer:' and the answer occupies the first line, so the line break is this task's turn boundary; the newline stop id set is derived from the tokenizer at run time, not hand-listed

superseded_readout_v1.decoding: greedy, max_new_tokens24, original EOS; no repetition/abstention bias
superseded_readout_v1.why: the checkpoint is chat-shaped while the prompt protocol is raw completion, so no turn boundary is ever reached and neither declared stop token is ever the argmax; run hlga-p3-20260909-cuda-math scored trimmed_exact 0.000 on ALL TEN arms with budget_exhaustion 1.000, while the reference arm emitted the correct answer as its first content in 47 of 72 cases
superseded_readout_v1.both_still_reported: trimmed_exact and strict_exact remain registered metrics and remain in the contrast report, so v1 and v2 can be compared side by side

compute_matching.frozen: Hold checkpoint/data/order/precision/backend/chunking/decoder fixed; report visible pairs, issued rectangles, full modeled matmuls and actual EOS length separately

future_compute_matched.cost_source: Profiled whole optimizer-update FLOPs or separately isolated update seconds; never attention-only FLOP ratios or 3x-forward heuristic
future_compute_matched.residual_policy: Floor whole updates, report unspent budget/cap hits; label not matched if residual exceeds 2%; no padding with fake work

future_training_requirements: Human-reviewed source/license/derivation declaration; exact content hashes; train/dev and duplicate/near-duplicate audits; no legacy sealed assets
Frozen backbone, gate-only allowlist and exact same trainable count across A4/A5/A6
Fix optimizer, LR, data membership/order, loss mask, supervision tokens and checkpoint selection before any pilot training
Token-matched and compute-matched ledgers answer distinct questions; more tokens under equal compute must not be called a same-data effect
At least three seeds; no checkpoint shopping; gate repair requires interaction versus all-global gate training
Independent sample-size/power plan, fixed noninferiority margins and multiplicity handling before confirmation
